directional_expectation: The frozen CD4 model without the vector block has higher heldout target-level R2 than the best competitive baseline.
pass_rule: Paired 95 percent CI is above zero, within-family q is below 0.05, calibration and coverage pass, and every estimable fixed stratum is directionally positive with no corrected reverse stratum.
fail_rule: Any required gate fails or the paired CI includes zero or a corrected reverse stratum is present.
unavailable_rule: No outcome-unopened dataset passes all eligibility and power gates.

directional_expectation: The full and without-vector frozen CD4 models retain calibrated interval coverage after outcome-free covariate-shift adjustment.
endpoint: calibration slope, intercept, and 50, 80, and 95 percent interval coverage
pass_rule: Slope is 0.80 to 1.20, absolute intercept is at most 0.10 outcome SD, every coverage error is at most 0.05, and within-family q is below 0.05 for improvement over the best baseline.
fail_rule: Any calibration or coverage boundary fails or improvement is not supported after correction.
unavailable_rule: Eligible target count is below 100 or prediction intervals cannot be reconstructed without heldout-outcome fitting.

directional_expectation: Portability gain is positive across source-frozen expression, response-degree, network-degree, response-magnitude, and transfer-class strata.
pass_rule: Every estimable level with at least 20 targets is positive and no reverse level has q below 0.05.
fail_rule: Any estimable level is negative with q below 0.05 or fewer than the prespecified strata can be evaluated after an otherwise eligible dataset is opened.
unavailable_rule: No level in a frozen stratum contains at least 20 eligible targets.

directional_expectation: Frozen cross-state core membership replicates in at least two independent primary human T-cell datasets.
endpoint: matched-target cross-state core-membership agreement above matched null
pass_rule: Each dataset is positive, the pooled clustered 95 percent CI is above zero, within-family q is below 0.05, and no dataset has a corrected opposite effect.
fail_rule: Fewer than two eligible datasets are positive or the pooled interval includes zero or a corrected opposite result occurs.
unavailable_rule: Fewer than two independent datasets pass all state, mapping, control, gene, cell, and repeated-unit gates.

directional_expectation: State-specific effect and rerouting directions agree across independent primary T-cell datasets beyond target and state matched nulls.
endpoint: matched-target state-specific sign and rerouting agreement
pass_rule: Clustered 95 percent CI is above zero and within-family q is below 0.05 in the pooled analysis with positive direction in both datasets.
fail_rule: The pooled interval includes zero, corrected significance fails, or either dataset has an opposite direction.
unavailable_rule: State-specific signed responses or repeated-unit uncertainty are unavailable in two eligible datasets.

directional_expectation: A training-selected nonlinear dose model improves heldout response error over the linear model across guides and donors.
pass_rule: Guide-held-out and donor-held-out effects agree, paired 95 percent CI is above zero, within-family q is below 0.05, calibration passes, and negative controls are null.
fail_rule: Any validation direction reverses, the interval includes zero, corrected significance fails, calibration fails, or a negative control is positive after correction.
unavailable_rule: Fewer than three supported guide efficacies, three donors, 30 cells per guide-donor, or 500 genes are available.

directional_expectation: Supported guide-dose response shapes remain stable after measurement-error sensitivity and guide and donor bootstrap.
endpoint: shape parameter and prediction calibration stability
pass_rule: Direction is unchanged across prespecified measurement-error scales, both bootstrap intervals exclude the null, and within-family q is below 0.05.
fail_rule: Direction changes or either bootstrap interval includes the null or corrected significance fails.
unavailable_rule: Guide efficacy uncertainty or donor-resolved profiles cannot be estimated under the frozen gate.

directional_expectation: Tier 1 or Tier 2 regulatory edges have higher guide-held-out and target-held-out directional concordance than matched unsupported edges.
pass_rule: Clustered 95 percent CI is above zero and within-family, matched-permutation, and degree-rewiring q values are below 0.05 with all conflicts reported.
fail_rule: The interval includes zero, any required corrected null fails, or unreported directional conflicts are found.
unavailable_rule: No eligible factor has state-compatible occupancy, active chromatin, verified mapping, provenance, and sufficient matched backgrounds.

directional_expectation: Direct-edge timing precedes secondary TF activity and downstream cascade response at compatible sampled times.
endpoint: ordered direct-edge, secondary-TF, and downstream-response timing score
pass_rule: Matched-permutation and degree-rewiring q values are below 0.05, the 95 percent CI is above zero, and no corrected directional conflict reverses the order.
fail_rule: The interval includes zero, a required null fails, or a corrected conflict reverses the order.
unavailable_rule: Compatible state and time measurements do not establish all three ordered components.

directional_expectation: Frozen CD4 programs show competitive genome-wide enrichment for immune-disease association beyond genomic and expression covariates.
pass_rule: MHC-excluded 95 percent CI is above zero, within-family q is below 0.05, colocalized loci support the direction, and matched negative controls are null.
fail_rule: The primary interval includes zero, corrected significance or colocalization support fails, or a negative control is positive after correction.
unavailable_rule: Complete summary statistics, ancestry-matched LD, immune-cell eQTLs, or state-relevant chromatin are unavailable.

directional_expectation: Colocalized program-linked instruments have directionally concordant disease effects without material heterogeneity or horizontal pleiotropy.
pass_rule: PP4 is at least 0.80 with PP4 over PP3 at least 3, F is at least 10, Steiger direction passes, heterogeneity and Egger-intercept q values are at least 0.05, leave-one-instrument direction is stable, and within-family q is below 0.05.
fail_rule: Any required instrument, directionality, heterogeneity, pleiotropy, or stability gate fails; no mediation claim is made.
unavailable_rule: Fewer than the required valid instruments or incomplete locus coverage prevents the frozen checks.

directional_expectation: Molecularly supported programs outperform matched unsupported programs across guide concordance, cross-state core membership, untouched portability, information retention, and disease relevance.
endpoint: joint standardized supported-minus-unsupported score across five outcomes
pass_rule: All five effects are positive, the joint clustered 95 percent CI is above zero, within-family, matched-permutation, and rewiring q values are below 0.05, calibration passes, and every leave-one-resource direction is stable.
fail_rule: Any outcome is nonpositive, the joint interval includes zero, a corrected null or calibration gate fails, or leave-one-resource direction reverses.
unavailable_rule: Any of the five component outcomes lacks an eligible independent estimate under its frozen gate.
